finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: The URL is hardcoded and not attacker-controlled, but if the URL were dynamically constructed from user input, it could lead to OS command injection.
finding.assumptions: The URL is hardcoded, but the code could be extended to accept user input for the URL, which would introduce a vulnerability.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The URL passed to CURLOPT_URL is a compile‑time constant string literal "http://httpbin.org/post" (line 42). No untrusted data source (stdin, argv, env, network, etc.) feeds into this string, and there is no code path that could replace it with user input. Therefore the conditions for a command‑injection vulnerability are not met.
